name: smartplay
author: Ulises961
description: Connects Navidrome to the smartplay engine, which writes playlists for each user you grant from what they star and play

engine_url.title: Engine address
engine_url.description: For example http://smartplay-engine:7788. The host must be listed in the plugin's permissions: see deploy/README.md

enrollment_code.title: Enrollment code
enrollment_code.description: One-time code printed by the engine

subsonicapi.reason: Read starred songs and write playlists as the granted users

users.reason: Act only for the users the admin granted

http.reason: Talk only to the engine, at the address set in the plugin's settings. The hosts it may reach are listed in requiredHosts, and only the engine's name is listed here: the range of its network is added when installing (deploy/README.md)
